text: {"name":"bt_connection_radio_metrics_process","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Aggregates eight radio measurements for a selected connection slot into category totals and overall and peak values.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"nonzero_measurement_count","v2":"connection_slot_record","v3":"sample_order","v4":"measurement_values","v6":"distinct_category_count","v7":"category_bitmap","v8":"peak_category_sum","v9":"total_measurement_sum","v12":"measurement_value","v13":"category_index","v15":"category_sum"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Connection-slot flags; processing requires bit 0x20."},{"offset":35,"meaning":"Selector used to choose a 36-byte radio-measurement record."},{"offset":37,"meaning":"Nonzero availability or validity flag for the connection-slot record."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Byte-sized guard field; a nonzero value skips processing."},{"offset":108,"meaning":"Byte-sized processing-enable or availability field."},{"offset":116,"meaning":"Connection-slot index."}]}
